newsitem.title: USA: Visioneer demonstrates portable color scanner.
newsitem.headline: Visioneer demonstrates portable color scanner.

text.p: Visioneer Inc Tuesday demonstrated a new portable color scanner and low priced scanning software which will enable people to scan images and place them automatically on a Web page in minutes.

Jeff Johnstone, a product manager at Visioneer, said the scanner could be used to scan images in 24-bit color at resolution of 300 dots per inch at a speed of about six seconds a page, and will cost around $300.

The PaperPort Web Publisher software, to be available in July priced at less than $30, will enable images to be automatically inserted into a formatted Web page with thumb- nail images linked to full size displays of the images.
"Most of us don't want to program (Web pages)," Johnstone said as he demonstrated the technology at the Upside/David Coursey Internet Showcase conference here.

The software, developed in just the last six weeks, enables text to be scanned, reformatted and added to the Web page, along with captions and a title. ((sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
